sources.fact: Authoritative Brownfield record LBBD57 identifies Woodward Road Garages, Dagenham.
Ownership-status is owned-by-a-public-authority; this is not a named current proprietor/title relation.
LBBD57 supplies a point and blank geometry and does not state a dwelling capacity.
A separate former Woodward Library redevelopment decision proposed circa 56 affordable homes and community space, subject to planning.
The 2019 Cabinet proposal described 39 Affordable Rent and 17 London Affordable Rent homes; this tenure mix is not transferred to LBBD57 without exact site overlap.
Planning Committee agreed reasons for approval for 20/00097/FUL and delegated grant subject to completion of a Unilateral Undertaking.
The application is at the junction of Stamford Road and Woodward Road/former library, while LBBD57 is named Woodward Road Garages; exact parcel equivalence is not established.
In September 2023, 23/01143/VAR changed 15 of 16 London Affordable Rent units to Discount Market Rent for the approved Woodward scheme; this does not resolve LBBD57 parcel identity.
March 2024 Cabinet approved long-lease disposal arrangements for the Woodward Road scheme expected to complete over coming months.
Delivery/disposal addresses are listed on Centenary Road; address lineage does not prove the 0.12ha LBBD57 garages boundary is the same parcel.
No exact HMLR/title relation binding LBBD57 to the former-library/Centenary Road scheme was verified this wave.

examples.result: LBBD57 remains not-permissioned and has no stated dwelling capacity.
The 56-home former-library scheme is not assigned to LBBD57 without exact overlap.
Committee delegated grant subject to an undertaking is not used to alter LBBD57 status automatically.
2019 tenure figures are not transferred to the garages record.
2023 tenure variation is not a new housing capacity.
2024 practical-completion/disposal evidence belongs to the identified Woodward scheme, not automatically LBBD57.
Centenary Road addresses are not converted into the LBBD57 legal polygon.
Promotion remains zero until exact parcel/title/application equivalence and overlays are verified.
